Germany's oldest pipe factory; dates by NAME floor (VAUEN coined 1909), the dot system (white = DE/AT market from the 1920s; blue/grey = export), filter-system floors (paper 1921, Dr. Perl 9mm 1934, Conex 1968) and stamped Pipe-of-the-Year years. history_anchors._doc: 1848 Karl Ellenberger + Carl August Ziener, Nuremberg = FIRST German pipe factory. 1901 merger with Gebhard Ott (f. 1866) -> Vereinigte Pfeifenfabriken Nurnberg (VPFN), managed by Ernst Eckert (Ott family). 1909: Adolf Eckert coins 'VAUEN' (V of Vereinigte + N of Nurnberg) -> the NAME FLOOR. 1920s: white-dot trademark for Germany/Austria; court case vs Dunhill split the world: VAUEN white dot ONLY in DE/AT, light-blue/grey dots everywhere else since. Dot = higher grades; VAUEN imprint alone = lower grades. 1921 paper filter; 1934 Dr. Perl junior 9mm activated-carbon filter (world first -> today >90% of German-market pipes are 9mm). 1968: Conex conical filter seat on MOST models (exceptions exist -- floor only, absence never dates). Family-run throughout; Alexander Eckert (5th gen) heads since 1982. Distributes Kansas (made by Achaiki Amadeus).

brand_marks.physical: Dot on mouthpiece = higher-grade Vauen (white in DE/AT, light-blue/grey export -- the Dunhill settlement). Lower grades: VAUEN imprint on stem only. 9mm filter chamber standard; Conex = conical filter-seat end in the mouthpiece (1968+).

table.label: the name VAUEN was coined 1909 -- any VAUEN-marked pipe is 1909+ (VPFN/Gebhard Ott marks = earlier company eras). PRIMARY SOURCE found 2026-07-18: Deutscher Reichsanzeiger 1909-10-12, Warenzeichen 121675 (V.3706), applied 1909-07-27, registered 1909-09-21, by 'Vereinigte Pfeifenfabriken vorm. Gebhard Ott und Ziener & Ellenberger AG'. NOTE (maker's own 1921 statement, Volksfreund Karlsruhe 1921-09-19): pre-WWI EXPORT pipes were NOT stamped with the mark -- a VAUEN-stamped pipe found outside Germany is practically ~1919/1921+ (single source, note only, no bracket change)
white dot = 1920s+ trademark AND a Germany/Austria-market pipe (export pipes got blue/grey after the Dunhill settlement)
blue/grey dot = export-market Vauen, post-settlement (settlement date approx 1920s -- verify exact year on enrichment)
Conex conical filter seat = 1968+ (floor; most but not all models -- absence never dates)

9mm filter chamber = Dr. Perl era, 1934+ floor. CAVEAT (DDB fulltext 2026-07-17): the Dr. Perl NAME predates the 9mm system -- 'Dr. Perls pat. Trockenrauch-Pfeifen' advertised 1930 (Harzer Volksstimme 1930-04-17 p.8, repeats; 117 hits 1930-32) and 'Trockenrauch-Patrone' tech advertised 1926 (Stuttgarter Neues Tagblatt 1926-11-01 p.10) -- so a Dr. Perl WORDMARK alone is NOT a 1934 floor; only the 9mm CHAMBER is. ANTEDATED AGAIN 2026-07-18 (ANNO, image-verified): 'Die Dr. Perl-Pfeife mit dem eingepraegten Namen VAUEN' advertised Pilsner Tagblatt 1927-12-11 p.4 ('beste Gesundheitspfeife der Welt', 1 Jahr Garantie, 'VAUEN sind seit 60 Jahren die besten' -> heritage math ~1867) -- Dr. Perl wordmark floor = 1927. See brand_research/vauen_dating/ddb_fulltext_facts.md
sterling crossed-pipes mark = Pipe of the Year series (1993+); the stamped year gives the EXACT date
DRGM = Reich-era utility mark (generic German rule)
